adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, immediately after `const credentialKey = credential.key...`, the code unconditionally calls `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and then performs `await prisma.credential.update(...)` before returning a `new jsforce.Connection(...)`. There is no expiry/validity check on the existing access token and no gating on `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` (unlike other integrations that now use `refreshOAuthTokens`). Because it throws on non-OK (`if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw ...`) and rejects on parse failure, previously-working calendar operations can now hard-fail whenever the refresh endpoint is unavailable, while also adding a network round-trip + DB write on each time this connection-building path runs.
